what: When the angular polygon window holding a photo enters the screen, it grows from .01× over 1s power2.out and unfolds from a point shape to the first shape over .75s back.inOut(.75). After that, endlessly, every 1.1s it twists into a different polygon over 1s power4.inOut (MorphSVG) while the photo inside cross-fades over 1s. The changing word in the center exits upward 105% over .5s power3.in, and the next word rises from below .5s later with power3.out. Two or three corner words move to per-shape positions (top · left · bottom · right %) over 1s power3.inOut. Stops when it leaves the panel

options.dur: Duration of one Type change (s), default 1
options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Clipped window — inside [data-fx-part=pic] items stack and swap in turn
options.[data-fx-part=corner]: Corner words (two to three, first on top, second bottom left, third bottom right)
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Swapping words (stacked in the same cell)
